name: What factors influence the total cost of an interior construction project?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of an interior construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Construction pricing is driven primarily by square footage, structural complexity, mechanical requirements, and the grade of finish materials chosen. Modifying load-bearing walls or running new electrical panels and plumbing stacks increases labor costs compared to working within an existing footprint. High-end finishes, such as custom tile, marble, or intricate finish carpentry, also demand specialized labor hours. Because hidden conditions inside older walls can occasionally present unexpected repairs, establishing a realistic contingency reserve of 10 to 15 percent helps manage necessary adjustments without halting construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on project size, structural modifications, plumbing and electrical updates, finish material selections, and any unforeseen repairs discovered behind walls.
